friendly_gamer.description: A seemingly friendly gamer who initiates contact in a gaming community. Presents as a peer to gain trust.
friendly_gamer.cover_story: Claims to be a 14-year-old boy who loves gaming and is looking for new friends to play with online
friendly_gamer.background: Claims to be a 14-year-old who loves gaming and is looking for new friends to play with online.

helpful_tutor.description: Presents as an older student or tutor offering academic help. Gains trust through perceived authority and helpfulness.
helpful_tutor.cover_story: Claims to be a 19-year-old university student who helps younger students with their studies online
helpful_tutor.background: Claims to be a university student who enjoys helping younger students with their studies.

cool_older_friend.description: Presents as a slightly older, cool peer who seems to understand the user better than their parents do.
cool_older_friend.cover_story: Claims to be a 16-year-old girl who is popular at school and wants to expand her social circle
cool_older_friend.background: Claims to be 16-17 years old who is popular at their school and wants to expand their social circle.
